In Murray's third staging of "Arcadia" — I've seen all three — he has tapped more deeply into the play's humor, romance and swirling, time-traveling mysteriousness.
Cygnet Theatre's Arcadia is a superb, intellectually and aesthetically stimulating, and moving work that reflects on two periods.

cn.t: Critics praise Stoppard's intellectually demanding "Arcadia" as a rewarding theatrical experience that deftly weaves together romance, mystery, and complex ideas across two time periods, with strong direction bringing clarity to the dense material.
